title: Bounds on work-tape head positions
statement: Let $W,B,P\in\mathbb N$ and let $C$ be a configuration with $m+k_D+1$ work tapes. The first $m$ work-tape heads each lie between $-1$ and $W$, inclusive; each of the next $k_D$ work-tape heads has absolute position at most $B$; and the final work-tape head has absolute position at most $P$.
hypotheses_covered: A program-node type $\Lambda$ and decider-state type $SD$
